title: Cuter post-Yes reveal styling with decorative assets and gentle motion

requirements.summary: Restyle the post-Yes reveal view into a noticeably cuter/softer presentation while preserving the existing meme image, heading, and romantic message text.
acceptanceCriteria: After clicking “Yes! 💕”, the reveal view has a clearly cuter/softer presentation than the current centered layout (e.g., pastel card/container treatment, softer shadows, rounded elements, cute decorative accents), without changing the flow of the app.
The meme image `/assets/generated/valentine-meme.dim_1200x900.png` is still displayed and remains the primary visual element.
The heading text “Good choice ❤️” remains exactly the same.
The romantic message paragraph remains exactly the same text as currently shown in the reveal view.

file_operations.description: Update only the `answered === true` reveal layout to use a softer, cuter composition (e.g., pastel card/container, rounded corners, gentle shadows, spacing) while keeping the same meme image source, heading text “Good choice ❤️”, and the exact same romantic message text. Do not add new screens or routing.

Add small, app-scoped utility classes (via @layer utilities) to support a softer reveal presentation (e.g., subtle glow/shadow helpers and any non-component styling needed), without modifying any files under `frontend/src/components/ui`.

requirements.summary: Add new static decorative image assets and render them on the reveal page directly from frontend public assets (no backend fetching).
acceptanceCriteria: The new decorative assets are present under `frontend/public/assets/generated` and are referenced directly by the frontend via `/assets/generated/...` paths.
Decorations enhance the reveal view while not obscuring the meme image, heading, or message on common screen sizes (mobile through desktop).

file_operations.description: Add the generated static decorative sticker asset at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/cute-stickers-1.dim_512x512.png` so it can be referenced directly by the frontend without any backend fetching.

Add the generated static repeating background pattern asset at the exact path `frontend/public/assets/generated/cute-pattern-bg.dim_1600x900.png` so it can be referenced directly by the frontend without any backend fetching.

In the `answered === true` reveal view, render the new decorative images using direct public paths, including `frontend/public/assets/generated/cute-pattern-bg.dim_1600x900.png` as a subtle background treatment and `frontend/public/assets/generated/cute-stickers-1.dim_512x512.png` as non-obscuring decorative accents positioned around the main content (ensure they do not cover the meme image, heading, or paragraph on mobile through desktop).

requirements.summary: Add at least one additional gentle, cute animation to the reveal page (beyond existing fade/scale) without causing layout shift or distracting motion.
acceptanceCriteria: Reveal page includes at least one additional subtle, cute animation (beyond the existing fade/scale) that runs smoothly and does not cause layout shift.
Animations respect usability (no rapid flashing; overall motion remains gentle).

file_operations.description: Add new keyframes + utility animation classes for gentle motion (e.g., slow float/bob for stickers and a subtle twinkle/sparkle effect) ensuring the animations are transform/opacity-based to avoid layout shift and remain non-distracting.

Apply the new gentle animation utilities to reveal-page decorative elements (e.g., sticker cluster and/or small accent elements) while preserving the existing reveal fade-in and meme scale-in feel; ensure animation usage is subtle and does not introduce layout shift.
